cabinCategories.description: MSC Poesia interior stateroom — European design sensibility with generous proportions and superior finishing.
Ocean view stateroom with panoramic window and MSC's signature style. A refined Alaska cabin at an accessible price.
Private balcony stateroom — MSC Poesia's balconies are notably spacious. Ideal for Inside Passage scenic sailing.
MSC Yacht Club suite — an exclusive ship-within-a-ship experience with private pool, restaurant, and 24-hour butler service.

inclusions: All meals in main restaurant and buffet

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). MSC Poesia brings European elegance and international style to the Alaska cruise market for 2026.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's scenic capital. Visit Mendenhall Glacier, go whale watching, or ride the Mount Roberts Tramway for panoramic views. Local king crab and Alaskan amber are a must.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: Klondike Gold Rush history lives on in Skagway's well-preserved downtown. The White Pass & Yukon Route Railway is among North America's most spectacular train experiences.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: A beautiful scenic sea day cruising the Inside Passage. Enjoy MSC Poesia's elegant Italian-designed spaces and international atmosphere while Alaska's wilderness rolls past.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: The Gateway to Alaska. Explore the world's largest collection of standing totem poles and the colorful Creek Street district.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: An elegant evening call in British Columbia's garden capital. The Inner Harbour and Butchart Gardens reflect Victoria's British charm.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: MSC brings a European flavor and an international crowd to Alaska, often at competitive fares — worth a look for value-conscious travelers who enjoy a cosmopolitan atmosphere.
